messages:
Alyssa (CSE): Quick heads-up — AtlasOps EBR dry run is Thursday 3pm PT. Need final slide pass, exec cue bullets, and a concise renewal risk summary (1 slide). Who can own the risk slide?
Mike R: I can take the risk slide. Will pull recent usage + support ticket trends. ETA EOD Wed. :thumbsup:
Jana S: I’ll own the product demo flow and create cue cards for execs (2 slides). Can someone add the short list of fallback talking points?
Kevin P: Adding fallback points now. Quick ask — what risk scoring granularity do we want? 0–5 or low/med/high?
Alyssa (CSE): Keep it simple: low / medium / high + one-sentence rationale. Execs prefer signal, not raw numbers.
Lina M: Tagging the enablement asks: training gaps (2 items), API onboarding blockers (3 items). Uploading slide draft -> https://redwood-drive.example/atlasops/ebr/drafts
CS Ops Bot: New file uploaded by Lina M: atlasops_enablement_v3.pptx (size 2.1MB)
Mike R: Quick data snippet I’ll surface on the risk slide: 30% month-over-month token usage dip, 4 SEV2 tickets in last 60d. If folks want other metrics tell me now.
Jana S: Include demo fallback: if live demo fails, show recorded walkthrough (30s) and call out performance SLOs.
Kevin P: For exec cue bullets: 1) Current health signal, 2) Key blockers we’re fixing, 3) Ask (resources or timeline). Drafting 3 bullets per cue now.
Alyssa (CSE): Perfect. Also add one line on renewal posture — likely renew if blockers resolved w/in 90d, else at-risk (medium). Keep phrasing actionable.
Lina M: Can ops provide a short timeline for the fixes? Ops/Platform PRs in flight: #2321 (cache fix), #2374 (routing). Expected deploy Thu PM.
Mike R: I’ll put a conservative note: deploy target Thu PM; monitor next 48h for usage rebound.
Jana S: Slide owners so far: Risk (Mike), Demo (Jana), Enablement (Lina). Alyssa — who will present the exec summary?
Alyssa (CSE): I’ll present the exec summary and own ask slide. Can everyone drop final slide edits into the folder by 1pm PT Thurs so I can stitch?
Kevin P: Done — I’ll add the final 3 bullets by 11am PT Thursday.
Lina M: Uploaded enablement slide v4 and checklist.
CS Ops Bot: Reminder: Calendar invite updated for AtlasOps EBR dry run — Thu 15:00 PT.
Mike R: One last note — capture customer feedback quotes (1–2) on the health slide. I’ll pull from last NPS thread and paste in.
Alyssa (CSE): Awesome. If anyone hits blockers, ping me or drop a quick Loom. Thanks team — let’s aim for a clean dry run. :rocket:
